message:
Let me check if there's a built fuzzer binary somewhere:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -name "assimp_fuzzer" -type f 2>/dev/null; find /workspace -name "*.a" -path "*assimp*" 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/build 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
